name: Gotar
lore: Gotar: Fort Atla on the north lakes and Nalliten on the east, wild country between. Gjalpinulva's drakulv buy the svartalf outcasts with scale and gold, and their scale-traders camp on the trade road by the old svartalf post with a dragon-preacher. A wreck off the east shore was carrying scale north; envy drakelings creep up from the south, and half the seithkona at the circle sing for the dragon now.

chains.title: The Drowned Ship
chains.hint: Oars creak on the shore where no ship floats...

stages.name: Clear Wreck
stages.objective: Clear the wreck
stages.announce: Captain Hrafn's crew have climbed out of the wreck to find a new ship. Send them back to the sea.
stages.success: You have cleared the wreck. Captain Hrafn of the Drowned comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the wreck. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Captain Hrafn of the Drowned
stages.objective: Defeat Captain Hrafn of the Drowned
stages.announce: Captain Hrafn of the Drowned stands at the wreck. Bring friends.
stages.success: Captain Hrafn of the Drowned falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Captain Hrafn of the Drowned slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Skeletal Seafarers Hold the Road to Fort Atla
stages.objective: Drive the skeletal seafarers off the road to Fort Atla
stages.announce: With The Drowned Ship lost, the skeletal seafarers have spread down onto the road to Fort Atla and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The skeletal seafarers are gone from the road to Fort Atla. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Hild, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Hild has come out to set the road to Fort Atla right. The skeletal seafarers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Fort Atla is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The skeletal seafarers break and scatter. The road to Fort Atla is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Hild falls, and the skeletal seafarers take the road back.

chains.title: The Hobgoblin Raid
chains.hint: Hobgoblins are giggling in the hills...

stages.name: Protect Asa the Net-Mender
stages.objective: Protect Asa the Net-Mender, who is saving the village nets
stages.announce: The hobgoblins are coming to cut the village nets again. Asa won't leave them - keep the hobgoblins off her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Asa the Net-Mender. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Asa the Net-Mender falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Net-drying Racks
stages.objective: Clear the net-drying racks
stages.announce: They came from the net-drying racks. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the net-drying racks. Snaggletooth comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the net-drying racks. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Snaggletooth
stages.objective: Defeat Snaggletooth
stages.announce: Snaggletooth stands at the net-drying racks. Bring friends.
stages.success: Snaggletooth falls. The way is safe again.

stages.name: The Hobgoblin Prowlers Hold the Road to Nalliten
stages.objective: Drive the hobgoblin prowlers off the road to Nalliten
stages.announce: With The Hobgoblin Raid lost, the hobgoblin prowlers have spread down onto the road to Nalliten and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The hobgoblin prowlers are gone from the road to Nalliten. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Sten, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Sten has come out to set the road to Nalliten right. The hobgoblin prowlers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Nalliten is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The hobgoblin prowlers break and scatter. The road to Nalliten is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Sten falls, and the hobgoblin prowlers take the road back.

chains.title: The Wildlings
chains.hint: Flayer Kegnar is looking for help in Fort Atla.

giver.name: Flayer Kegnar
giver.greet: The wildlings have been setting their wolves on our hunters. I'm going to have a word with their chieftain - with my axe. Coming? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Wildling Camp
stages.objective: Go with Flayer Kegnar to the wildling camp
stages.announce: Flayer Kegnar marches out of Fort Atla to the wildling camp.
stages.success: Flayer Kegnar reaches the wildling camp. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Flayer Kegnar falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Wildling Camp
stages.objective: Clear the wildling camp
stages.announce: Clear the wildling camp!
stages.success: You have cleared the wildling camp. Wildling Chieftain Skarn comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the wildling camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Wildling Chieftain Skarn
stages.objective: Defeat Wildling Chieftain Skarn
stages.announce: Wildling Chieftain Skarn stands at the wildling camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: Wildling Chieftain Skarn falls. Fort Atla will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Wildling Chieftain Skarn slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Wildlings Hold the Road to Fort Atla
stages.objective: Drive the wildlings off the road to Fort Atla
stages.announce: With The Wildlings lost, the wildlings have spread down onto the road to Fort Atla and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The wildlings are gone from the road to Fort Atla. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Sten, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Sten has come out to set the road to Fort Atla right. The wildlings are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Fort Atla is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The wildlings break and scatter. The road to Fort Atla is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Sten falls, and the wildlings take the road back.

chains.title: The Imp Revel
chains.hint: Shrill laughter and smoke come from the pines...

stages.name: Clear Imps' Revel
stages.objective: Clear the imps' revel
stages.announce: The imps are holding a revel in the pines and setting fire to anything that will burn. Break it up.
stages.success: You have cleared the imps' revel. Kvist the Imp-King comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the imps' revel. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Kvist the Imp-King
stages.objective: Defeat Kvist the Imp-King
stages.announce: Kvist the Imp-King stands at the imps' revel. Bring friends.
stages.success: Kvist the Imp-King falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Kvist the Imp-King slips away - for now.

chains.title: The Scale-Caravan
chains.hint: Wagon-bells on the trade road - a scale-caravan is coming up from the south...

stages.name: The Outriders
stages.objective: Break the caravan's svartalf outriders on the trade road
stages.announce: A drakulv scale-caravan is coming up Gotar's trade road from the south! Huscarl Hallbjorn wants it stopped - break its outriders!
stages.success: The outriders break - and the caravan whips its beasts on, north toward the svartalf post, with its master walking beside it.
stages.fail: The outriders drive you off the road, and the caravan rolls on north.

stages.name: Scale-Master Naudr
stages.objective: Hunt down Scale-Master Naudr on the trade road
stages.announce: Scale-Master Naudr, a svartalf in mail of red dragon-scale, walking beside his wagons up the road: 'The Mother pays in gold. What do you pay in?' He walks the road between his wagons and the svartalf post - hunt him down. Bring friends.
stages.success: Naudr falls in the road, and his wagons stop. They're full of dragon-scale - warm, every one - and a letter bound for Malmohus.
stages.fail: Naudr gets his wagons to the svartalf post, and the scale goes north.

chains.title: The Drowned Bell
chains.hint: A bell ringing out at sea, where no ship floats - the wreck is calling its crew...

stages.name: The Skald's Verse
stages.objective: Keep Skald Ingvild alive while she sings the drowned to rest
stages.announce: The wreck's bell is ringing and the drowned are coming ashore! Skald Ingvild of Fort Atla is on the beach singing them to rest - keep her alive!
stages.thanks: "Every drowned man deserves a verse. Even the ones who row for dragons."
stages.success: The drowned lie down in the surf one by one - all but the last, who walks up out of the sea with the ship's wheel still in his hands.
stages.fail: Ingvild falls, and the drowned walk inland.

stages.name: the Drowned Steersman
stages.objective: Defeat the Drowned Steersman
stages.announce: The Drowned Steersman, weed in his ribs, a red scale nailed to his wheel: 'We carried her scale. We were promised the shore.'
stages.success: The Steersman falls, and the bell out at sea stops ringing.
stages.fail: The Steersman walks back into the sea, and the bell rings on.
